docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $264.00 FILED BY KIRBY DWIGHT AS TO DEFENDANT CAMPERO JESUS DBA CAMPEROS ANYTHING ORTHOPEDIC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-16-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
